SELECT AH.ASNDKY , AI.ASNDIT , AI.STATIT , NVL((SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'STATIT' AND CMCDVL = AI.STATIT),' ') AS STATITNM , AI.SEBELN , AI.SEBELP , AI.STKNUM , AI.STPNUM , AI.SKUKEY , NVL(SM.DESC01,'NOT EXISTS SKUMA') AS DESC01 , NVL((SELECT LOCAKY FROM WAZLM WHERE WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND LOGGRP = CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '11%' THEN 'NOR' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '12%' THEN 'TRN' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '13%' THEN 'RTN' ELSE ' ' END AND LSTRTY = AH.DRELIN AND LOTA10 = CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '11%' THEN 'HS' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '12%' THEN AI.LOTA10 WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '13%' THEN 'RH' END ),'NOT EXISTS DATA') AS LOCAKY , ' ' AS TRNUID , AI.QTYASN , AI.QTYRCV AS QTYPRE , AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV AS QTABLE , AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV AS QTYRCV , NVL(SM.DUOMKY,' ') AS UOMKEY , NVL(SW.MEASKY,' ') AS MEASKY , NVL((SELECT LOTA10 FROM WAZLM WHERE WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND LOGGRP = CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '11%' THEN 'NOR' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '12%' THEN 'TRN' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '13%' THEN 'RTN' ELSE ' ' END AND LSTRTY = AH.DRELIN AND LOTA10 = CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '11%' THEN 'HS' WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '12%' THEN AI.LOTA10 WHEN AH.ASNTTY LIKE '13%' THEN 'RH' END ),'NOT EXISTS DATA') AS LOTA10 , NVL(TRIM(AI.LOTA11), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS LOTA11 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12 , NVL(TRIM(AI.LOTA13), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(NVL(TRIM(AI.LOTA11), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')),'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(SM.QTYMON,1) - 1,'YYYYMMDD')) AS LOTA13 , NVL(SM.QTYMON,1) AS EXPIRED_LIMIT , CASE WHEN VD.PTNRKY IS NULL THEN '존재하지 않는 SELLER 마스터 입니다.' WHEN TRIM(VD.PROCHA) IS NOT NULL THEN '입고불허된 SELLER 입니다.' WHEN TRIM(VD.DELMAK) IS NOT NULL THEN '마스터 삭제된 SELLER 입니다.' WHEN SM.SKUKEY IS NULL OR SW.SKUKEY IS NULL THEN '존재하지 않는 SKU 마스터 입니다.' WHEN TRIM(SW.IBPROT) IS NOT NULL THEN '입고불허된 SKU 입니다.' WHEN TRIM(SM.DELMAK) IS NOT NULL THEN '마스터 삭제된 SKU 입니다.' END RSTTXT , AI.INVCNO , AI.OINVNO , SM.SKUG05 , VD.NAME01 , SM.EANCOD , MI.QTPUOM FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN BZPTN VD ON VD.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND VD.PTNRKY = SM.SKUG05 AND VD.PTNRTY = 'VD' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = SM.DUOMKY WHERE AH.ASNDKY = #{ASNDKY} AND TRIM(AH.DELMAK) IS NULL AND AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV > 0 AND AI.STATIT = 'NEW'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IFWMS203 ( SEQNO, SEQIT , ORDTYP, STKNUM, STATUS , CHGDTH , WARETO , DRELIN , WAREFR , STPNUM, SKUKEY, ITMSTS , QTYASN, QTYRCV , RSNCOD, RSNMSG , CHGDTI , RECVKY, RECVIT , IFFLG, ERTXT , CREDAT, CRETIM , SKUG05 , PROCDT, PROCTI , ASNDKY, ASNDIT ) SELECT #{SEQNO}, ROWNUM , AI.SAPSTS, AI.STKNUM, #{STATUS} , SYSDATE AS CHGDTH , NVL((SELECT CMCDVL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKUWAREKY' AND USARG1 = AH.WAREKY),'X') AS WARETO , NVL((SELECT CMCDVL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKULSTORY' AND USARG1 = AH.WAREKY AND USARG2 = AH.DRELIN),'X') AS DRELIN , CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY = '111' THEN ' ' WHEN AH.ASNTTY = '121' THEN AH.DPTNKY ELSE 'X' END AS WAREFR , AI.STPNUM, AI.SKUKEY, 'IP100' AS ITMSTS , AI.QTYASN, AI.QTYRCV , NVL((SELECT MAX(RI.PRCRSN) FROM RECDI RI WHERE RI.REFDKY = AI.ASNDKY AND RI.REFDIT = AI.ASNDIT AND RI.STATIT != 'FCN'),' ') AS PRCRSN , NVL((SELECT MAX(RI.PRCRST) FROM RECDI RI WHERE RI.REFDKY = AI.ASNDKY AND RI.REFDIT = AI.ASNDIT AND RI.STATIT != 'FCN'),' ') AS PRCRST , SYSDATE AS CHGDTI , ' ' AS RECVKY, ' ' AS RECVIT , 'N', ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CREDAT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CRETIM , SM.SKUG05 , ' ' AS PROCDT, ' ' AS PROCTI , AI.ASNDKY, AI.ASNDIT FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY WHERE AI.ASNDKY = #{ASNDKY}

INSERT INTO IFWMS203 ( SEQNO, SEQIT , ORDTYP, STKNUM, STATUS , CHGDTH , WARETO , DRELIN , WAREFR , STPNUM, SKUKEY, ITMSTS , QTYASN, QTYRCV , RSNCOD, RSNMSG , CHGDTI , RECVKY, RECVIT , IFFLG, ERTXT , CREDAT, CRETIM , SKUG05 , PROCDT, PROCTI , ASNDKY, ASNDIT ) SELECT #{SEQNO}, ROWNUM , AI.SAPSTS, AI.STKNUM, 'IS100' AS STATUS , SYSDATE AS CHGDTH , NVL((SELECT CMCDVL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKUWAREKY' AND USARG1 = AH.WAREKY),'X') AS WARETO , NVL((SELECT CMCDVL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKULSTORY' AND USARG1 = AH.WAREKY AND USARG2 = AH.DRELIN),'X') AS DRELIN , CASE WHEN AH.ASNTTY = '111' THEN ' ' WHEN AH.ASNTTY = '121' THEN AH.DPTNKY ELSE 'X' END AS WAREFR , AI.STPNUM, AI.SKUKEY, 'IS100' AS ITMSTS , AI.QTYASN, 0 AS QTYRCV , ' ' AS RSNCOD, ' ' AS RCPRSNS , SYSDATE AS CHGDTI , ' ' AS RECVKY, ' ' AS RECVIT , 'N', ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CREDAT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CRETIM , AI.SKUG05 , ' ' AS PROCDT, ' ' AS PROCTI , AI.ASNDKY, AI.ASNDIT FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AH.ASNDKY = AI.ASNDKY WHERE AH.ASNDKY = #{ASNDKY}

INSERT INTO IFWMS204 ( SEQNO, SEQIT , ORDTYP, SPOSNR, STRAID, SVBELN , SGDKEY, SGDNAM, SGDQTY , OGDNAM, OGDQTY , OINVNO, INVCNO , CLMRSN, EXCTYP , RCVDAT , STATUS , STKNUM , WARETO , SKUKEY , QTYASN, QTYRCV , RECVKY, RECVIT , IFFLG, ERTXT , CREDAT, CRETIM , PROCDT, PROCTI , RSNMSG , ASNDKY, ASNDIT ) SELECT #{SEQNO}, ROWNUM , AI.SAPSTS, AI.SPOSNR, AI.STRAID, AI.SVBELN , AI.SGDKEY, AI.SGDNAM, AI.SGDQTY , AI.OGDNAM, AI.OGDQTY , AI.OINVNO, AI.INVCNO , AH.CLMRSN, RI.RSNCOD , SYSDATE AS RCVDAT , 'IP100' AS STATUS , AI.STKNUM , NVL((SELECT CMCDVL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKUWAREKY' AND USARG1 = AH.WAREKY),'X') AS WARETO , AI.SKUKEY , AI.QTYASN, RI.QTYRCV , RH.RECVKY, RI.RECVIT , 'N', ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CREDAT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CRETIM , ' ' AS PROCDT, ' ' AS PROCTI , RI.PRCRST , AI.ASNDKY, AI.ASNDIT FROM RECDH RH INNER JOIN RECDI RI ON RI.RECVKY = RH.RECVKY INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = RI.REFDKY AND AI.ASNDIT = RI.REFDIT INNER JOIN ASNDH AH ON AH.ASNDKY = AI.ASNDKY WHERE AI.ASNDKY = #{ASNDKY} AND RI.STATIT IN ('NEW', 'RDV')
